UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated ZipLink user profile stored per Firebase Auth UID. Strictly isolated to the owning user; never stores GitHub tokens or server secrets.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: Display name shown in the ZipLink account header.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-only user profile documents keyed by Firebase Auth UID.
